segment.source: Resource Monitor
segment.target: 资源监控器

segment.source: Authors: Alex Hall, Joseph Lee, Kefas Lungu, Beqa Gozalishvili, Tuukka Ojala, Ethin Probst, Kevin Derome and other NVDA contributors
segment.target: 作者: Alex Hall, Joseph Lee, Kefas Lungu, Beqa Gozalishvili, Tuukka Ojala, Ethin Probst 和其他NVDA贡献者

segment.source: This add-on gives information about CPU load, memory usage and other resource usage information.
segment.target: 该插件可读出 CPU 负载，内存使用情况和其他资源使用信息。

segment.source: Shortcuts
segment.target: 快捷键

segment.source: All commands support speech on demand mode.
segment.target: 所有命令都支持手动朗读模式。

segment.source: NVDA+Shift+E: enters the Resource Monitor command layer.
segment.target: NVDA+Shift+E: enters the Resource Monitor command layer.

segment.source: The following layer commands are available to obtain individual resource usage information:
segment.target: The following layer commands are available to obtain individual resource usage information:

segment.source: Space: overall resource usage information including used RAM (physical memory) and average processor load.
segment.target: Space: overall resource usage information including used RAM (physical memory) and average processor load.

segment.source: C: CPU (average processor load and if multicore CPU's are present the load of each core)
segment.target: C: CPU (average processor load and if multicore CPU's are present the load of each core)

segment.source: D: disks (used and total space of the fixed (built-in), removable, and network drives)
segment.target: D: disks (used and total space of the fixed (built-in), removable, and network drives)

segment.source: G (unavailable in secure mode): graphics processing unit (GPU) information
segment.target: G (unavailable in secure mode): graphics processing unit (GPU) information

segment.source: Shift+G(unavailable in secure mode): GPU memory usage
segment.target: Shift+G(unavailable in secure mode): GPU memory usage

segment.source: M: memory (used and total space for both physical and virtual RAM (NVDA+Shift+5 is an alternative to NVDA+Shift+2 when the latter keyboard combination cannot be performed))
segment.target: M: memory (used and total space for both physical and virtual RAM (NVDA+Shift+5 is an alternative to NVDA+Shift+2 when the latter keyboard combination cannot be performed))

segment.source: O: operating system (Windows version, CPU architecture, and exact build number (build.revision))
segment.target: O: operating system (Windows version, CPU architecture, and exact build number (build.revision))

segment.source: U: system uptime
segment.target: U: system uptime

segment.source: W: wi-fi (network name (SSID), signal strength, security mode, or no SSID if there is none available)
segment.target: W: wi-fi (network name (SSID), signal strength, security mode, or no SSID if there is none available)

segment.source: Resource commands keep the layer active so they can be repeated. Press Escape to exit the layer; an unmapped key exits and is passed through the active application.
segment.target: Resource commands keep the layer active so they can be repeated. Press Escape to exit the layer; an unmapped key exits and is passed through the active application.

segment.source: For limited backward compatibility, the previous NVDA+Shift+1 through NVDA+Shift+7 resource shortcuts remain available:
segment.target: For limited backward compatibility, the previous NVDA+Shift+1 through NVDA+Shift+7 resource shortcuts remain available:

segment.source: NVDA+Shift+1: CPU
segment.target: NVDA+Shift+1: CPU

segment.source: NVDA+Shift+2/5: memory
segment.target: NVDA+Shift+2/5: memory

segment.source: NVDA+Shift+3: disks
segment.target: NVDA+Shift+3: disks

segment.source: NVDA+Shift+4: wi-fi
segment.target: NVDA+Shift+4: wi-fi

segment.source: NVDA+Shift+6: operating system
segment.target: NVDA+Shift+6: operating system

segment.source: NVDA+Shift+7: system uptime
segment.target: NVDA+Shift+7: system uptime

segment.source: You can change these gestures via the input gestures dialog.
segment.target: You can change these gestures via the input gestures dialog.

segment.source: Usage notes
segment.target: 使用说明

segment.source: This add-on does not replace task manager and other system information programs for Windows. Also note the following:
segment.target: 此插件不替换 Windows 的任务管理器和其他系统信息程序。另请注意以下事项：

segment.source: Pressing resource commands twice will copy resource usage information to the clipboard.
segment.target: Pressing resource commands twice will copy resource usage information to the clipboard.

segment.source: Resource information cannot be copied to the clipboard if running the add-on in secure screens.
segment.target: 在安全界面运行插件时，无法将资源信息复制到剪贴板。

segment.source: CPU usage is given for logical processors, not physical cores. This is noticeable for processors with Hyper-Threading where number of CPU's is twice the number of CPU cores. On some newer computers, not all CPU cores will have hyper-threading enabled.
segment.target: 给出的 CPU 使用情况是针对逻辑处理器而非物理核心。这对于使用超线程的处理器来说是显而易见的，其中 CPU 数量通常是 CPU 核心数量的两倍。在一些较新的计算机上，并非所有 CPU 核心都启用了超线程。

segment.source: If there is heavy disk activity such as copying large files or while locating network drives, there might be delays when obtaining disk usage information.
segment.target: 如果存在大量磁盘活动，例如复制大文件或查找网络驱动器，则在获取磁盘使用情况信息时可能会出现延迟。

segment.source: GPU information is given for Nvidia GPU's.
segment.target: GPU 信息仅适用于英伟达 GPU。

segment.source: When announcing processor architecture information as part of Windows version reporting, "AMD64" refer to 64-bit (x64) Intel and AMD processors. This information does not refer to the name of the actual processor in use.
segment.target: 读出 Windows 版本时给出的处理器架构信息中的“AMD64”是指 64 位（x64）的 Intel 和 AMD 处理器。此信息并非指当前使用的实际处理器名称。

segment.source: Installing the add-on on Windows 10/11 LTSC is not supported.
segment.target: 不支持在 Windows 10/11 LTSC 上安装本插件。

segment.source: For a list of changes made between each add-on releases, refer to [changelogs for add-on releases][1] document.
segment.target: 有关每个插件版本之间的所做更改，请参阅[插件更新日志（英语）][1]文档。
